### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. cone-rod dystrophy 2  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.720)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2383)

**Proposed mechanism:** CRX (HGNC:2383) —DISRUPTS→ Photoreceptor development and function (GO:0048744); Photoreceptor development and function (GO:0048744) —LEADS_TO→ Leber congenital amaurosis 5 (MONDO:0013449); Photoreceptor development and function (GO:0048744) —LEADS_TO→ Cone-rod dystrophy 2 (MONDO:0007362). Mutations in the CRX gene disrupt photoreceptor development and function, leading to both Leber congenital amaurosis 5 and cone-rod dystrophy 2.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of patients with pathogenic variants in CRX who do not exhibit either Leber congenital amaurosis 5 or cone-rod dystrophy 2, or the identification of distinct molecular pathways for each disease not involving CRX function. _(variant: rs113810596 (p.R90W) observed at a frequency > 1% in gnomAD exomes.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CRX in photoreceptor function provides a common target for therapeutic strategies aimed at treating both Leber congenital amaurosis 5 and cone-rod dystrophy 2, such as gene augmentation or gene editing therapies.
